

# setup.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/setup-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(setup_shims OBJECT setup.c)
target_link_libraries(setup_shims PRIVATE libuserenv libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(setup_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(setup setup-cargo setup.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS setup_shims psdk)
